Section 23A — Strategic acquirer threshold

(1) For the purposes of this Part, a relevant merger situation is also created if —

(a) two or more enterprises have ceased to be distinct enterprises at a time or in circumstances falling within section 27; and

(b) the conditions in subsection (2) are met.

(2) The conditions are that —

(a) in relation to the supply of goods or services of any description, the share of supply in the United Kingdom of the enterprise carrying on the activities to which the description relates is at least 25%; and

(b) the value of the consideration for the acquisition is at least £10 million.
